statements.t: There is no assurance that we will pursue an alternative liquidity event in the near future, if at all.
If we fail to continue to qualify as a REIT, our operations and distributions to stockholders, if any, will be adversely affected.
For the remainder of 2026, we anticipate investing approximately $4.1 million for capital expenditures and tenant improvements.

The decrease in total property operating expenses is primarily due to decreases of (i) $903 in real estate tax expense and (ii) $607 in non-recoverable expenses, partially offset by increases of: (i) $331 in repairs and maintenance expense due to timing of projects, (ii) $233 in utilities expense, (iii) $178 in landscaping expenses due to additional landscape projects, (iv) $151 in insurance expense and (v) $129…
Neither FFO nor MFFO is intended to be an alternative to “net income” or to “cash flows from operating activities” as determined by GAAP as a measure of our capacity to pay distributions.
